about_short_description.short_description: The Operating system for next-generation airlines

product.name: Farel Platform
product.description: An all-in-one cloud-native software platform for managing airline inventory, sales, and operations without multiple vendor integrations.

product.name: Internet Booking Engine (IBE)
product.description: A no-code tool to launch an airline website quickly, enabling direct flight sales through a customizable online booking interface.

product.name: Mobile App
product.description: A branded mobile application tailored for airlines to access the mobile-only travel market and increase direct bookings.

product.name: API for Inventory Distribution
product.description: APIs that enable airlines to list their flight inventory on online travel agencies, meta-search platforms, and aggregators to increase visibility and bookings.

product.name: Agency Platform
product.description: A travel agency portal that enables seamless flight distribution to offline and business travel agencies for broader market access.

product.name: Integrated Payments Platform
product.description: A payment system integrated within the airline platform offering multiple payment options to passengers during booking.
